title: Events, Keys, and Topics
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Events, Keys, and Topics.
learning_objectives: Explain events, keys, and topics using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for events, keys, and topics
Assess failure and operational limits of events, keys, and topics
concepts_covered: A topic is an append-only event stream; a message key helps decide which partition receives an event.
Producer config keys click events by session_id; deterministic event IDs are described in README.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
